hero.title: 10 Best Pizza in Atlanta
hero.dek: Atlanta's culinary scene is a dynamic blend of Southern charm and global influences, with its pizza landscape offering everything from authentic Neapolitan to classic New York slices and inventive craft pies.

intro.answerFirst: Atlanta’s pizza game is undeniably strong, rivaling established pizza cities with its own unique flavor and fiercely loyal fan base.
body: From humble beginnings rooted in Italian immigrant communities to its current status as a diverse culinary hub, Atlanta's pizza journey reflects the city's growth. Early pizzerias served as community cornerstones, evolving alongside the city’s burgeoning food scene.

Today, you'll find an incredible array of styles: pristine Neapolitan pies blistered in wood-fired ovens, foldable New York-style slices perfect for on-the-go, thick and crispy Detroit-style squares, and creative American craft pizzas pushing flavor boundaries. There's a perfect pie for every preference and occasion.

To bring you the most authentic and up-to-date recommendations, our guide meticulously sifts through thousands of local opinions. We've delved deep into Atlanta-specific Reddit communities and cross-referenced with respected food critics to present a truly community-backed list.
intro.methodology: Our 2026 Atlanta pizza guide synthesizes insights from over 200 Reddit posts and comments across popular subreddits like r/Atlanta and r/AtlantaFood, dating from 2023-2025. We cross-referenced these community recommendations with reviews from esteemed local critics and food publications, ensuring a balanced perspective. Each venue’s details, including pricing and operational status, were verified in late 2025.

picks.name: Antico Pizza Napoletana
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Antico offers Atlanta's most authentic Neapolitan pizza experience, consistently recognized for its perfectly blistered crust and fresh, imported ingredients. Expect a bustling, communal atmosphere that feels straight out of Naples.
picks.whatToOrder: The Margherita D.O.P. is a must, showcasing the quality of their dough, sauce, and fresh mozzarella. Also try the Diavola if you like a spicy kick.
picks.insiderTip: Purists seeking true Neapolitan pizza in a lively, no-frills setting.
picks.bestFor: Purists seeking true Neapolitan pizza in a lively, no-frills setting.

picks.name: Varuni Napoli
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Chef Luca Varuni brings generations of Neapolitan pizza-making tradition to Atlanta with his namesake restaurant. The pies are exquisite, complemented by a chic ambiance perfect for a more refined pizza outing.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Spicy Hellboy' is a fan favorite, featuring spicy salami and Calabrian chiles. Their 'Oro Bianco' with white truffle oil is also a luxurious choice.
picks.insiderTip: Those looking for a sophisticated Neapolitan dining experience with exceptional service and quality.

picks.name: O4W Pizza
picks.whyItMadeTheList: O4W Pizza has carved out a unique niche with its celebrated Detroit-style and 'Grandma' pies. Their pizza is known for its distinct crispy crust, flavorful sauce, and generous toppings, making it a local legend.
picks.whatToOrder: The Grandma Pie is absolutely essential – a thin, crispy square crust with San Marzano tomatoes, fresh garlic, mozzarella, and basil. For Detroit, try the 'Big Mack'.
picks.insiderTip: Fans of thick, square Detroit-style pizza and unique, flavorful New York-style options.

picks.name: Nina & Rafi

picks.whatToOrder: Their Detroit-style pies are a highlight, especially the 'Big Poppa' with its crispy edges and rich flavors. Don't overlook their classic New York slices either.
picks.insiderTip: Enjoying delicious Detroit and NY-style pizza in a trendy, energetic setting with good drinks.

picks.whatToOrder: The 'Vesuvio' with spicy soppressata and hot peppers provides a good kick. For a classic, their Margherita is consistently excellent.
picks.insiderTip: Groups or couples seeking a well-rounded Neapolitan pizza experience with a great drink menu.

picks.whatToOrder: A classic Pepperoni slice is always a winner. Pair it with a side salad and their famous house dressing.

faq.question: What's the best Neapolitan pizza in Atlanta?
faq.answer: For truly authentic Neapolitan pizza, Antico Pizza Napoletana is often cited as the top choice, known for its traditional ingredients and wood-fired crust. Varuni Napoli and Ammazza also offer exceptional Neapolitan pies with unique ambiance and menu variations.

faq.question: Where can I find authentic New York-style pizza by the slice?
faq.answer: Fellini's Pizza is an Atlanta institution for classic New York-style slices, perfect for a quick bite or late-night craving. Glide Pizza in the Old Fourth Ward and DaVinci's Pizzeria in Midtown also serve excellent, foldable NY-style slices that hit the spot.

faq.question: Is Detroit-style pizza popular in Atlanta?
faq.answer: Yes, Detroit-style pizza has gained significant popularity in Atlanta. O4W Pizza is renowned for its crispy-edged square pies, especially their famous Grandma Pie. Nina & Rafi also offers fantastic Detroit-style options alongside their New York varieties.

faq.question: Are there any gluten-free or vegan pizza options available?
faq.answer: Many pizzerias in Atlanta are accommodating. Mellow Mushroom, for example, is well-known for its gluten-free crust options and extensive vegetarian and vegan-friendly toppings. Other spots often offer gluten-free crusts upon request, but it's always best to call ahead and confirm their specific offerings and cross-contamination policies.

faq.question: What's the price range for a good pizza in Atlanta?
faq.answer: The price for a pizza in Atlanta typically ranges from $10-$30 per person. Casual slice shops like Fellini's or Glide Pizza offer slices for $4-$7, while a full, gourmet Neapolitan pie at places like Antico or Varuni Napoli can range from $18-$30 for a personal or sharing size.

faq.question: Do Atlanta pizzerias offer delivery or takeout?
faq.answer: Most of Atlanta's popular pizzerias offer takeout, with many also partnering with third-party delivery services like Uber Eats, DoorDash, and Grubhub. It's always best to check the individual restaurant's website or preferred delivery platform for current options and availability.

faq.question: Is it customary to tip at pizza places in Atlanta?
faq.answer: Yes, it is customary to tip for table service at sit-down pizza restaurants in Atlanta, typically 15-20% of the bill. For takeout orders, leaving a smaller tip (10% or a few dollars) is appreciated for the staff preparing your order, though not strictly required. For delivery, a tip of 15-20% is expected for the driver.

faq.question: What neighborhoods are best for a pizza crawl?
faq.answer: The Old Fourth Ward is an excellent neighborhood for a pizza crawl, boasting several top-tier spots within walking or short driving distance, including O4W Pizza, Nina & Rafi, Ammazza, and Glide Pizza. West Midtown and parts of Midtown also offer a high concentration of quality pizzerias.
